Nvidia Board Rejects Jensen Huang's Return as CEO

Nvidia's Board of Directors has stated it does not intend to reinstate co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO, despite reported pressure from some figures in the tech industry and public calls for his return. Board Chairman Harvey Jones confirmed the company's stance, noting that Heidrick & Struggles has been hired to find a permanent leader. Interim CEO Colette Kress is currently overseeing operations during an investigation into Huang's departure. Separately, Nvidia has established a new board committee to oversee national security, export controls, and global trade risks.
